notice.title: Help us better understand collaboration in founder teams.
notice.body:
If you like, we may use your answers and usage data in pseudonymised form for scientific research on collaboration in founding teams — including free text, and also outside CoFoundery, for example in a publication.

Separately from that: to check whether our questions are understandable, we look at how often each answer option was chosen. That happens without reference to individuals and is part of running CoFoundery — we do not need your consent for it and therefore do not ask.

Taking part is voluntary. You can use CoFoundery just the same if you do not.

settings.title: Research participation
settings.description: You decide freely whether your answers and usage data may be used in pseudonymised form for scientific research — including free text. Whether our questions are understandable is checked separately, using frequencies without any reference to individuals.
settings.withdrawal:
After you stop, we store no new research data and delete what can still be attributed to you.

What cannot be undone: analyses in which your answers have already been combined with those of others. Your share cannot be subtracted back out of a frequency across a hundred people, and what has been published stays published.
